tx: To make a primed chaos bar, players need 39 Thieving and a pair of cosmic gloves. Place the blocks 'Operate' and 'Chaos' into the CPU (large machine in middle of chaos room on the level 3 of the workshop). This will programme the automaton to pull down the lever, giving the chaos machine power. With the cosmic gloves on and at least 39 Thieving, place a primed bar in the jig and manually operate the draining machine. This will lower the thieving level. Remove the chaos bar from the jig. If players brought multiple primed bars and super restore potions, they simply repeat the steps to make the automaton operate the chaos machine to power it again, and manually operate the draining machine again with a new primed bar in the jig. A Thieving cape can also be used to restore the Thieving level, albeit more slowly.
